scope: Fictional local prototype only; no production service, APIs, JS or CSS modified.
status: No remaining blocking layout defects in independently checked states. Reported target-size defects were fixed and rechecked.
coverage_limits: 390 home was navigated but not independently measured or captured.
1440 editor, poster list, film list, detail, memory dialog and composer were not independently repeated in this subtask; the root agent separately reported PC home/film/detail/modal verification.
This is representative visual/layout QA, not exhaustive accessibility or functional regression.
Pointer drag behavior was assigned to another agent and is not certified here.
Only one representative shelf card was measured before/after hover.

overflow.note: Values are document.documentElement.scrollWidth. Shelf and film internal scrolling are intentional; off-viewport children clipped by those scroll containers are not page overflow.

verified: selected segmented tab radius 0px, transparent background, 2px bottom border
visual_tokens.exception: Inner .frame-image and its artwork were measured at 0px radius. Do not describe every image element as 2px.

findings.issue: Brand and auxiliary links had undersized hit areas
findings.resolution: Brand now 44px high; auxiliary links intentionally 24px high. Not an all-controls-44px claim.

findings.issue: Mobile Entire/Completed filter chips were only 39.02px wide
findings.resolution: Final mobile film main controls were measured with no width/height below 44px.

findings.issue: Old inherited pill/background remained on segmented controls
findings.resolution: Final screenshots and computed styles show radius 0, transparent background and 2px lower border.

intermediate_screenshots_note: Other interaction-v5-* images without -final- in the filename were captured before the last CSS corrections. They are preserved as intermediate evidence, not final design references.
final_image_review: The final 320 home, film and detail screenshots were opened with view_image; no unexpected clipping or page-level horizontal overflow was observed.
